slides.title: Fund the pilot before committing to rollout

points.support: Quarterly demand rises from 80 to 120 thousand orders; the current network handles 100.
A $0.4m test validates throughput before a further $0.8m is released.
Scale only after on-time delivery reaches 98% for four consecutive weeks.

slides.bottom_line: Approve $0.4m now; review the rollout gate on 15 January 2027.

slides.title: Q4 demand exceeds capacity by 20 thousand orders
insights: Q4 demand is a forecast, not a committed order book.
The base case is 20% above current capacity.
The pilot tests an additional 25 thousand orders per quarter.
slides.takeaway: Gate the capacity investment on measured service performance.
